supersedes: BC-PACK-EVT1-001 (hardware/pcb/evt1/pack-spec.json): 2-wire pack, two separate tape-on NTCs and a JST ACH disconnect, for the two-board EVT1. Kept as that design's record.
description: Factory-built protected 1S high-rate LiPo pack with an internal 10 k NTC and three leads ending in a JST SH 3-pin plug, for the one-board Compass device
status: Defined for RFQ; not submitted, no supplier accepted, no sample received
why_three_wires: The pack's own NTC is the battery temperature sensor: it drives the BQ24074 TS pin (hardware charge cutoff, no firmware involved) and is read by the firmware on U7 AIN2 through R88/C88. It replaces the two separately bought, tape-coupled Vishay NTCs of BC-PACK-EVT1-001.
reference_3wire_construction: EEMB LP502030-PCM-NTC-LD: size, PCM and NTC wiring reference only; confirm its continuous rating against this request before offering it
load_note: Carried over from BC-PACK-EVT1-001: motor converter plus ESP32-C3 radio peaks at a low pack voltage. The board's JST SH connector is rated 1 A per contact, below this; see open_items.

protection_requirements.overcurrent_and_short: Supplier to give thresholds, delays, FET loss and temperature, recovery behaviour and evidence for the continuous and pulse load. Do not derive trip values from the cell's headline C rating.
protection_requirements.charge_recovery: Recover from undervoltage protection by a 4.2 V-limited charger on P+/P-; give the exact recovery conditions.

thermistor.mount: Bonded to the cell's broad face under the pack wrap, away from the PCM, so it reads cell temperature, not PCM self-heating.
thermistor.wiring: Between the NTC lead (pin 3) and P- (the protected output negative, pin 2). It must not return to cell B- ahead of the PCM FETs (their drop shifts the reading at load), and the PCM must not load or share it.
thermistor.device_use: BQ24074 TS: 75 uA (72..78) bias, charge stops above 0.3 V hot / 2.1 V cold, about 0 C to 51 C with this curve (R42 470 k to 3V3 shifts the hot trip about +2 C). Firmware reads the same node on U7 AIN2.

device_frame_envelope_mm.note: One-board device frame (hardware/pcb/evt1/one-board/mech/compass_datums.py): Y along the body axis toward the tip, pack in the body bulb, PCM and lead end at Y 31.75 facing the neck. Same 33 x 21 x 6.3 maximum as BC-PACK-EVT1-001.

leads.exit: PCM short end, facing the neck (device -Y), near the pack's centre line
leads.length_note: Modelled path from the pack to J2 is about 70 mm (mech/internals-fit.json); 90 mm minimum allows dressing. Length is from the pack case to the back of the plug housing.

connector.contacts: SSH-003T-P0.2-H, crimped with JST tooling (wire range AWG 28..32)
connector.mates_with: J2, JST SM03B-SRSS-TB side-entry header on the one-board B.Cu
connector.polarity_note: There is no polarity standard for 3-pin battery plugs. The pinout above is mandatory; the supplier confirms it on the drawing and every sample is checked with a meter before the first mate.

assembly_reason: The cap/body module threads with the pack leads free; the pack is plugged into J2 afterwards. Nobody solders the pack.
open_items: Contact current: JST SH is rated 1 A per contact, below the 1.5 A continuous / 2 A pulse request. Before ordering, measure the real continuous battery current with the motor running and the radio active. If it can exceed 1 A, J2 and the plug need a higher-rated connector that still fits the 4 mm cavity.
Supplier drawing must confirm the NTC part, its curve, mounting and its return to P-.
Transport documents (UN 38.3 summary) for the finished pack.
